name: Booked for Love: Staffed for the Summer
source:
You and your best friend will be spending the summer working at the Blue Oceans Hotel! You accidentally end up working as a “Team member”… Which you quickly find out is just a fancy way of saying you’re gonna be helping out on the jobs no one else wants to do. Lucky for you, you’ll be working alongside a cast of “interesting” coworkers…

Hopefully, something will happen to make this summer unforgettable… Right?

[From [url=https://ps-studio.itch.io/bookedforlove]itch.io[/url]]
